unit_note: USD millions. Page 25, Table 6 Schedule C, Borrowing from the US Treasury: Department of Agriculture through Foreign Agricultural Service. Dots and (**) are omitted. All 17 printed lines are kept. 18 roll-forwards (12 exact, 6 within 1; rounding note on p27). The column total, Total Borrowing from the US Treasury (p26), spans the five Schedule C unit files; their lines foot to it within 3 in every column.
